retired.name: Silk Pizzicato
retired.reason: Cross-category overlap with the retained string voice; replaced by a more distinctive pluck.

method: All 421 current native presets rendered at three registers; cosine features for whole-note spectrum, first 213ms spectrum and 96-point amplitude envelope, weights .45/.20/.35. Closest redundant variants removed within musical-role budgets.
limitations: Feature similarity is not perceptual identity. Different MIDI, macros, sound systems and taste can change perceived similarity. Role budgets deliberately also remove less distinctive alternatives to reach 300.
reference_notes: Bass/acid C2; other roles C4, with register transpositions
